popCulture.title: Palamedes (mythology)
popCulture.description: The inventor Odysseus framed and stoned — Palamedes remains the Trojan War's emblem of cleverness turned lethal.

popCulture.title: Trojan War
popCulture.description: The man who exposed Odysseus' feigned madness dies by planted gold — a Cypria episode that haunted later tragedy.
